lore.fortune_spells.staff.keys: Hold Shift for powers · Hold Alt for the inscription
lore.fortune_spells.staff.master: As master of %s, you receive its sovereign power:
lore.fortune_spells.staff.mana: Gain a thousand mana and twice your spell power.
lore.fortune_spells.staff.malice: The malice of the gods cannot touch you.
lore.fortune_spells.staff.doom: You will outlast the end of days.
lore.fortune_spells.staff.cosmos: When the cosmos falls silent and all things fade, it endures.
advancement.fortune_spells.glimpse.title: Glimpse the Future
advancement.fortune_spells.glimpse.descr: Obtain an item from an unknown fate.
advancement.fortune_spells.legend.title: Legend
advancement.fortune_spells.legend.descri: Become a legendary mage without equal.
advancement.fortune_spells.beyond_fate.d: Seek an audience with the eternal sovereign.
advancement.fortune_spells.creator.title: Creator
title.fortune_spells.creator: Master of %s · Creator of All
spell.fortune_spells.audience.guide: Pour four bottles of Transcendent Ink into an Alchemist's Cauldron and add any one Meet Your Fight boss trophy to create the scroll. Offer materials at thirteen seals to forge a staff and give it a name. The ritual drains 1 mana per second.
spell.fortune_spells.cataclysm.guide: Chant for 30 seconds with the Audience staff. Light from the great field converges on nine descending rings for one impact. Damage equals maximum mana × fire spell power × 50. Release expends all remaining mana.
message.fortune_spells.cataclysm.staff_o: Cast this spell with a staff forged in the Audience ritual.
message.fortune_spells.aerial_view: Press %1$s to return to your character or %2$s to fly the camera
message.fortune_spells.audience.scroll_o: Audience can only be cast from a scroll. It cannot be inscribed in a spell book.
message.fortune_spells.audience.boss_off: Offer a different Meet Your Fight boss drop at each inner seal.
message.fortune_spells.audience.occupied: Use an empty hand to retrieve this offering.
ui.fortune_spells.level_cooldown: Base cooldown at this level: %s s
death.attack.fortune_spells.phantom_belf: %1$s heard the last toll of %2$s's phantom belfry
spell.fortune_spells.phase_shift.guide: Pass through walls. Higher levels last longer and take longer to recharge.
spell.fortune_spells.burrow.guide: Burrow underground with 50% more movement speed. Strike nearby enemies when you emerge.
spell.fortune_spells.croc_devour.guide: Summon spectral jaws to devour foes in front of you, inflict Decay, and recover health after the bite.
spell.fortune_spells.phantom_belfry.guid: Raise a spectral belfry. Eight tolls summon sonic pillars, then the final peal strikes all foes and stuns them for three seconds.
spell.fortune_spells.bell_shockwave.guid: Send a golden sonic wave straight through walls and foes.
spell.fortune_spells.rose_wraiths.guide: One or two rose spirits emerge from pentagrams and hover at your side. Their tether guards you for 3 seconds. Parrying a melee hit blocks 80% of its damage and triggers a counter. When the guard ends, the spirits pursue a target and explode. Both the counter and the blast scale with spell power.
Dance through incoming hits, scattering petals with every slash. Detonate the petals in a field of sunset fire.
spell.fortune_spells.bone_wings.guide: Gain flight and 50% movement speed until your ten additional gray hearts are depleted.
spell.fortune_spells.card_selection.guid: Deal five cards and reveal the target. Find it again after the shuffle to become Fortune's Chosen.
spell.fortune_spells.blind_gamble.guide: Bet without looking. Win and be Fortune's Chosen for a long time; lose and be Forsaken by Fate, your mana drained.
spell.fortune_spells.all_in.guide: Stake everything on the next blow: your next attack deals double damage.
effect.fortune_spells.blessed_by_fortune: Attacks have a 50% chance to deal double Fate damage, ignoring armor, defenses and damage caps.
effect.fortune_spells.cursed_by_fate.des: Your mana stays at 0. Neither death nor cleansing will free you.
effect.fortune_spells.all_in.description: Your next attack deals double damage.
ui.fortune_spells.blind_lose: Lose: Forsaken by Fate for %s min
ui.fortune_spells.cast_error_in_game: You are still in a card game
hud.fortune_spells.card_game.pick_hint: Aim at a card and press Attack or Use
hud.fortune_spells.card_game.timeout: Fate picked a card for you
